# Risk Assessment Workshop

<!-- BREADRUMB PLACEHOLDER -->

---

> Systematic identification, analysis, and mitigation planning for project, operational, and strategic risks.

---
page_texts.3:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#purpose]

### Purpose

Systematically identify, assess, and develop mitigation strategies for risks that could impact project success, operational effectiveness, or strategic objectives.
page_texts.4:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#objectives]

### Objectives

- Identify comprehensive range of risks across all relevant categories
- Assess risk probability, impact, and overall risk exposure
- Develop practical and effective risk mitigation strategies
- Prioritize risk response efforts based on risk levels and organizational capacity
- Establish risk monitoring and management processes for ongoing oversight
page_texts.5:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#success-criteria]

### Success Criteria

- **Comprehensive Risk Identification**: All significant risks identified and documented
- **Accurate Risk Assessment**: Risks properly assessed for probability and impact
- **Effective Mitigation Plans**: Practical, actionable risk mitigation strategies developed
- **Clear Risk Ownership**: Risk owners assigned with clear accountability

---

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#2-weeks-before-workshop]

### 2 Weeks Before Workshop

**Risk Context Analysis:**

- [ ] Define risk assessment scope and boundaries
- [ ] Review project, operational, or strategic context
- [ ] Gather existing risk documentation and lessons learned
- [ ] Identify risk assessment stakeholders and subject matter experts

**Risk Framework Setup:**

- [ ] Establish risk categories and classification system
- [ ] Define risk probability and impact scales
- [ ] Prepare risk assessment tools and templates
- [ ] Set up risk register and tracking mechanisms
page_texts.8:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#1-week-before-workshop]

### 1 Week Before Workshop

**Stakeholder Preparation:**

- [ ] Brief participants on risk assessment process and expectations
- [ ] Distribute pre-workshop materials and context information
- [ ] Coordinate with risk owners and subject matter experts
- [ ] Prepare workshop materials and facilitation tools

**Workshop Setup:**

- [ ] Confirm participant availability and roles
- [ ] Set up workshop environment and technology
- [ ] Prepare risk assessment templates and scoring tools
- [ ] Brief facilitators on scope and sensitive areas

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#project-risks]

#### Project Risks

- **Schedule Risks**: Delays, dependency failures, resource unavailability
- **Scope Risks**: Scope creep, requirement changes, unclear specifications
- **Resource Risks**: Skills gaps, team availability, budget constraints
- **Quality Risks**: Defects, performance issues, user acceptance problems
page_texts.19:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#technical-risks]

#### Technical Risks

- **Technology Risks**: Technology maturity, integration complexity, scalability
- **Architecture Risks**: Design flaws, technical debt, maintainability issues
- **Security Risks**: Vulnerabilities, compliance gaps, data protection
- **Infrastructure Risks**: System failures, capacity limitations, disaster recovery
page_texts.20:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#business-risks]

#### Business Risks

- **Market Risks**: Competition, demand changes, economic conditions
- **Operational Risks**: Process failures, service disruptions, compliance issues
- **Financial Risks**: Budget overruns, funding availability, cost escalation
- **Strategic Risks**: Strategic misalignment, stakeholder resistance, priority changes
page_texts.21:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#organizational-risks]

#### Organizational Risks

- **People Risks**: Key person dependency, skills shortages, change resistance
- **Cultural Risks**: Cultural misalignment, communication breakdowns, conflict
- **Governance Risks**: Decision delays, authority confusion, accountability gaps
- **External Risks**: Vendor failures, regulatory changes, environmental factors
page_texts.22:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#risk-assessment-matrix]

### Risk Assessment Matrix

| Risk Level   | Probability | Impact           | Description                           | Response Strategy                    |
| ------------ | ----------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | -------- |
| **Critical** | High        | High             | Immediate threat to success           | Avoid or Transfer                    |
| **High**     | High        | Medium or Medium | High                                  | Significant concern requiring action | Mitigate |
| **Medium**   | Medium      | Medium           | Moderate concern requiring monitoring | Mitigate or Accept                   |
| **Low**      | Low         | Any or Any       | Low                                   | Minor concern, monitor only          | Accept   |
page_texts.23:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#risk-register-template]

### Risk Register Template

```markdown
## Risk ID: [RISK-XXX]

### Risk Description

**Risk Statement**: [Clear description of what could go wrong]
**Risk Category**: [Project/Technical/Business/Organizational]
**Risk Source**: [What could cause this risk to occur]

### Risk Assessment

**Probability**: [Very Low/Low/Medium/High/Very High] - [1-5]
**Impact**: [Very Low/Low/Medium/High/Very High] - [1-5]
**Risk Score**: [Probability x Impact = Score]
**Risk Level**: [Critical/High/Medium/Low]

### Impact Analysis

**Cost Impact**: [Financial consequences if risk occurs]
**Schedule Impact**: [Timeline effects and delays]
**Quality Impact**: [Effect on deliverables and outcomes]
**Stakeholder Impact**: [Effect on stakeholders and relationships]

### Risk Response

**Response Strategy**: [Avoid/Transfer/Mitigate/Accept]
**Mitigation Actions**: [Specific actions to reduce probability or impact]
**Contingency Plan**: [Actions if risk occurs despite mitigation]
**Risk Owner**: [Person responsible for managing this risk]

### Monitoring

**Risk Indicators**: [Early warning signs to monitor]
**Review Frequency**: [How often to assess this risk]
**Status**: [Open/In Progress/Closed/Occurred]
**Last Updated**: [Date of last risk assessment update]
```

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#risk-assessment-facilitation-techniques]

### Risk Assessment Facilitation Techniques

**Comprehensive Risk Discovery**

- Use multiple identification techniques to ensure complete coverage
- Encourage open discussion of concerns and potential problems
- Balance optimism with realistic assessment of potential issues
- Create safe environment for sharing sensitive or controversial risks

**Objective Risk Evaluation**

- Use structured scoring criteria to ensure consistent assessment
- Encourage evidence-based probability and impact evaluation
- Facilitate discussion to reach consensus on risk levels
- Validate assessments with subject matter expert input

**Practical Risk Response Planning**

- Focus on actionable, realistic mitigation strategies
- Balance mitigation effort with risk exposure level
- Ensure risk responses are assigned to capable owners
- Consider cost-benefit analysis for expensive mitigation actions
page_texts.26:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#common-risk-assessment-challenges]

### Common Risk Assessment Challenges

**Risk Identification Blind Spots**

- **Challenge**: Missing important risks due to limited perspective
- **Solution**: Use multiple stakeholder viewpoints and structured frameworks

**Optimism Bias**

- **Challenge**: Underestimating probability or impact of risks
- **Solution**: Use historical data and objective assessment criteria

**Analysis Paralysis**

- **Challenge**: Spending too much time analyzing without taking action
- **Solution**: Time-box analysis, focus on high-priority risks first

**Implementation Follow-through**

- **Challenge**: Risk plans created but not implemented
- **Solution**: Clear ownership, regular monitoring, and accountability

- **Priority Risk Action Plan**: Immediate actions for highest priority risks

- **Risk Owner Assignments**: Clear accountability for risk management

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#follow-up-deliverables-within-1-week]

### Follow-up Deliverables (Within 1 Week)

- **Comprehensive Risk Management Plan**: Detailed risk management strategy and processes
- **Risk Monitoring Dashboard**: Tracking and reporting mechanisms
- **Contingency Plans**: Detailed response plans for critical risks
- **Risk Communication Strategy**: Stakeholder communication and escalation procedures

### Ongoing Risk Management (Ongoing)

- **Regular Risk Reviews**: Periodic assessment and update of risk status
- **Risk Monitoring Reports**: Regular reporting on risk indicators and status
- **Risk Response Implementation**: Execution of mitigation actions and plans
- **Risk Process Improvement**: Continuous improvement of risk management practices

page_texts.32:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#risk-assessment-quality]

### Risk Assessment Quality

- **Risk Coverage**: Comprehensive identification across all relevant categories
- **Assessment Accuracy**: Appropriate probability and impact scoring
- **Response Effectiveness**: Practical, actionable mitigation strategies
- **Stakeholder Engagement**: Active participation from all relevant perspectives
page_texts.33:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#risk-management-effectiveness]

### Risk Management Effectiveness

- **Risk Reduction**: Measurable reduction in risk exposure through mitigation
- **Issue Prevention**: Fewer issues occurring due to proactive risk management
- **Response Readiness**: Quick, effective response when risks do occur
- **Cost Avoidance**: Financial benefits from risk prevention and mitigation
page_texts.34:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#process-maturity-indicators]

### Process Maturity Indicators

- **Proactive Identification**: Regular, systematic risk identification practices
- **Integrated Management**: Risk management integrated into project and operational processes
- **Continuous Improvement**: Regular refinement of risk management practices
- **Organizational Learning**: Lessons learned from risk events applied to future activities

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#project-risk-assessment-half-day]

### Project Risk Assessment (Half Day)

- Focus on project-specific risks and timeline
- Project team and key stakeholder participation
- Emphasis on schedule, scope, and resource risks
- Suitable for project initiation or major milestone gates

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#strategic-risk-assessment-full-day]

### Strategic Risk Assessment (Full Day)

- Comprehensive organizational and strategic risk evaluation
- Executive and senior leadership participation
- Focus on business, market, and competitive risks
- Suitable for annual strategic planning or major transformation
page_texts.38:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#operational-risk-review-half-day]

### Operational Risk Review (Half Day)

- Focus on ongoing operational and process risks
- Operations team and process owner participation
- Emphasis on service delivery and business continuity
- Suitable for regular operational risk management

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/risk-assessment.md#crisis-risk-assessment-2-hours]

### Crisis Risk Assessment (2 Hours)

- Rapid risk assessment for crisis situations
- Emergency response team participation
- Focus on immediate and short-term risks
- Suitable for crisis response and business continuity planning
